en_title: Sony PlayStation Patent Would Solve Problems With AI Vibe-Coded Patches
cn_title: 索尼专利拟让AI为PlayStation写修复补丁
subtitle: 修好还是修坏？
opus_summary: 索尼申请专利，拟让AI监测PlayStation故障，并用大语言模型编写补丁，提前修复问题或向工程师报告。但系统数据可能被AI获取，补丁也可能扩大故障；专利能否落地尚不明确。

paragraphs.en: Anyone who's had a console knows that on a long enough timeline they will have some kind of technical bug that you need to troubleshoot, and Sony is trying to get around that reality with an AI tech support agent.
paragraphs.cn: 用过游戏主机的人都知道，时间久了，主机难免会出现需要排查的技术故障。索尼正尝试用AI技术支持助手来解决这个问题。

paragraphs.en: Sony has filed a patent for an AI that would keep an eye on your system, looking for any kind of red flags and then uses an LLM to write up a patch for your system, to either preemptively fix the problem or to send a report to engineers at Sony. The problem is, that unless you can turn this feature off, all the data processed on your PlayStation would potentially be visible to this agent, because to successfully monitor a system for any and all hardware and software issues, it'll likely need total access to the system.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼已申请一项专利：让AI持续监测主机系统，寻找各种异常迹象，再用大语言模型编写系统补丁，以便提前修复问题，或向索尼工程师提交报告。问题在于，如果用户无法关闭这项功能，AI助手就可能看到PlayStation处理的所有数据。要监测系统可能出现的各种软硬件问题，它很可能需要获得完整的系统访问权限。

paragraphs.en: It's also possible that the system could make small issues into much larger ones. As Patentlyze , which found the patent says "an automated system sending repair instructions to a device in your living room needs careful guardrails so a small hiccup does not become a larger one." After all, the PlayStation 5, and likely the PlayStation 6 are just specialized computers, and there have been plenty of times that I've broken something by fixing a small problem that I probably could have just ignored (or wasn't a real problem to begin with.)
paragraphs.cn: 这套系统还可能把小问题变成大故障。发现这项专利的Patentlyze指出：「自动化系统向你客厅里的设备发送修复指令时，必须有周全的防护措施，以免小故障演变成大问题。」毕竟，PS5以及很可能同样如此的PlayStation 6，本质上都是专用计算机。我就有过不少次这样的经历：为了修复一个本来或许可以忽略、甚至一开始就不存在的小问题，反而弄坏了别的东西。

paragraphs.en: There's also a possibility that, unless the LLM has particularly strong training and guardrails, that it could make a mistake when coding these on-demand patches, and accidentally brick people's PlayStations.
paragraphs.cn: 此外，如果大语言模型没有经过足够充分的训练，也缺乏严格的防护措施，它在编写这些按需生成的补丁时就可能出错，意外让玩家的PlayStation主机变砖。

paragraphs.en: It's not clear when or if this patent will actually materialize into an AI tech support agent for your Playstation. However, with the death of discs for the PlayStation 6 , it's likely that Sony's next generation console is going to require an always-on Internet connection to begin with. And with that constant communication with Sony's servers, an AI system like this would be trivial to implement. So if anything, I'd guess that this feature will make its debut with Sony's next-generation platform, which will hopefully give the company enough time to work out the logistics and privacy risks that are inherent to remote AI monitoring.
paragraphs.cn: 目前尚不清楚这项专利是否会变成PlayStation上的AI技术支持助手，也不知道如果成真会在何时推出。不过，随着PlayStation 6的实体光盘走向消亡，索尼的下一代主机很可能本来就需要始终联网。主机若能持续与索尼服务器通信，实现这样的AI系统便轻而易举。因此，真要猜的话，我认为这项功能会在索尼下一代平台上首次亮相。希望这能给索尼足够的时间，解决远程AI监测在实际运作和隐私方面固有的风险。
